INDOMITABLESPIRE2-TAKE_A_BREAK.title: Take a Break
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-TAKE_A_BREAK.descripti:
Heal [green]{Heal:diff()}[/green] HP.
Gain [blue]{MotivationPower:diff()}[/blue] [gold]Motivation[/gold].
End your turn.
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-IGNITE.title: Ignite
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-IGNITE.description:
Can only be played if you have at least [blue]{MotivationRequire:diff()}[/blue] [gold]Motivation[/gold].
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Apply [blue]{OnFirePower:diff()}[/blue] [gold]On Fire[/gold].
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-DUAL_PURPOSE_GUN.title: 4.5-Inch Dual-Purpose Gun
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-ZIGZAG_MANEUVER.title: Zigzag Maneuver
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-ZIGZAG_MANEUVER.descri:
Can only be played if you have at least [blue]{MotivationRequire:diff()}[/blue] [gold]Motivation[/gold].
Gain {Block:diff()} Block.
Gain {DexterityPower:diff()} [gold]Dexterity[/gold] this turn.
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-WORK_ARRANGEMENT.title: Work Arrangement
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-WORK_ARRANGEMENT.descr:
Consume [blue]{MotivationConsume:diff()}[/blue] [gold]Motivation[/gold].
Draw {Cards:diff()} cards.
Put a card from your hand on the bottom of your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-WORK_ARRANGEMENT.selec: Choose a card to put on the bottom of your Draw Pile.
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-ILLUSTRIOUS_AEGIS.desc:
Grant any player {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
This Block is retained at the end of your turn, and heals [green]{Heal:diff()}[/green] HP when fully broken.
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-SWORDFISH_BOMBER.title: Swordfish
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-BARRACUDA_MK2.title: Barracuda Mk.II
[gold]Durability[/gold]: {Durability}/{MaxDurability}
Deal double damage ({Damage:diff()}) to targets with [gold]Block[/gold]. Apply [gold]Armor Break[/gold] equal to the un-doubled damage.
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-SEAFIRE_F46.title: Seafire F.46
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-SEAFIRE_F46.descriptio:
[gold]Durability[/gold]: {Durability}/{MaxDurability}
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. If the enemy intends to attack, apply [blue]{InterceptedPower:diff()}[/blue] [gold]Intercepted[/gold], otherwise gain [blue]{Block:diff()}[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold].
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-SEAFIRE_FR47.title: Seafire FR.47
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-TACTICAL_TRAINING.desc: Choose a [gold]Carrier Aircraft[/gold] card in your [gold]Hand[/gold]. Gain [blue]{SpecialPowerAmount:diff()}[/blue] corresponding Aviation power (or generic [gold]Aviation[/gold] if without sub-type).
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-TACTICAL_TRAINING.sele: Choose a Carrier Aircraft card for Tactical Training.
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-TROUBLE_HANDLING.title: Trouble Handling
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-INDOLENT.title: Indolent
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-INDOLENT.description:
Whenever you draw this card, lose {MotivationLoss} [gold]Motivation[/gold].
Discard a card.
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-REFRESH.title: Refresh
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-ART_OF_RESTING.title: Art of Resting
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-ART_OF_RESTING.banter: All forms of relaxation serve a purpose, and are DEFINITELY not slacking off.
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-ART_OF_RESTING.descrip:
[gold]Transform[/gold] all [gold]Indolent[/gold] cards in your piles into [gold]Refresh[/gold].
Whenever you create a Status card, [gold]Transform[/gold] it into a [gold]Refresh[/gold].
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-MOTIVATION_BURST.title: Motivation Burst
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-DISPATCH_COMMISSION.de: Another player adds 1 random{IfUpgraded:show: [gold]Upgraded[/gold]} [gold]Commission[/gold] card to their [gold]Hand[/gold].
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-OIL_COMMISSION.title: Oilfield Dev.
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-OIL_COMMISSION.descrip:
Playable after gaining {MaxProgress:energyIcons()}{InCombat: ({Progress}/{MaxProgress})|}.
You and {InCombat:[gold]{DelegatorName}[/gold]|the Delegator} each gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-EXERCISE_COMMISSION.de:
Playable after dealing {MaxProgress} damage to enemies{InCombat: ({Progress}/{MaxProgress})|}.
You and {InCombat:[gold]{DelegatorName}[/gold]|the Delegator} each gain {PowerAmount:diff()} [gold]Strength[/gold] and [gold]Dexterity[/gold].
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-TRANSPORT_COMMISSION.d:
Playable after drawing {MaxProgress} cards{InCombat: ({Progress}/{MaxProgress})|}.
You and {InCombat:[gold]{DelegatorName}[/gold]|the Delegator} each draw {Cards:diff()} {Cards:plural:card|cards}.
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-ESCORT_COMMISSION.desc:
Playable after gaining {MaxProgress} [gold]Block[/gold]{InCombat: ({Progress}/{MaxProgress})|}.
After combat, you and {InCombat:[gold]{DelegatorName}[/gold]|the Delegator} each gain {Gold:diff()} [gold]Gold[/gold].
